start.name: Forge
start.description: A lantern hangs from a hook beside a heavy anvil. A brass key glints on the floor. Nobody mentions the coins.

lantern.name: Lantern
lantern.description: Takeable and named in the prose.

anvil.name: Anvil
anvil.description: Named in the prose but not takeable.

coin.name: Coin
coin.description: Takeable; the prose says coins, which is a different word.
